text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin assessing the newborn's respiratory distress, could you please describe the specific symptoms and when they first appeared after birth?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the prematurity and maternal diabetes, I need to know if the baby is exhibiting grunting, nasal flaring, or retractions, and whether they are currently receiving supplemental oxygen or mechanical ventilation.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Respiratory distress. I also have Tachypnea, Subcostal and intercostal retractions, Nasal flaring, Cyanosis.
